purpose: Archived numerical evidence for reanalysis; these records are not fresh training or raw sensor traces.

files.transformation: Renamed architecture and training labels; removed internal source filenames. Numeric values unchanged.

Redundant baseline rows omitted: both-site fixed-one results are in architecture_training.csv; CRISP and native-training comparators are also there. Retained all other sampling-site and sharpening interventions.
Original variable-endpoint slope experiment; this is separate from the matched fixed-five versus annealed-one-to-five experiment.
Flattened completed matched-control test JSONL. All 12 selected checkpoints and their source protocol hashes are preserved; no numbers taken from the older variable-budget control.
Sampler-level observations retained. Architecture-level diagnostics use an unweighted mean over sampler sites within each trained model, then mean and sample SD over seeds.

LIF transfer-rule selection is a test-selected oracle comparator, not validation selection. Inference modes differ by architecture and are retained. Calibrated columns use labelled data and are not the data-free endpoint.
Fine-step results for both binning schemes and event-count-binned transfer controls. Fixed-time coarse-to-fine records are in time_step_transfer.csv, avoiding duplicate observations.
Retains final-epoch, validation-best and patience-20 observations as distinct columns. The main fixed-budget learning comparison uses last_graded; validation-best is not substituted.

Regularization levels expressed by coefficient and target, not internal labels. Two-sided certificate columns apply only to CRISP; LIF uses deterministic spikes. Operation counts are analytical, not measured energy.

Two-sided certificate only. Primary model comparisons are marked. The source audit totals (reference_comparisons, reference_disagreements, maximum_cell_disagreement_rate, audit_cells) aggregate BOTH alpha levels and are repeated in each alpha row: deduplicate units before summing them. Accuracy and abstention columns are alpha-specific. Cached draws are reused across test cells. Extra sparsity audit groups are retained separately. A comparison bound includes reference uncertainty; it is not an adversarial robustness radius.

units.clear_mb: MiB (2**20 bytes), peak allocated memory above the pre-call baseline
units.inference_mb: MiB (2**20 bytes), peak allocated memory above the pre-call baseline

files.transformation: Archived numerical report transcription. Individual timing traces, memory traces or per-input diagnostic observations are not present in this table; do not treat rows as repeated experimental runs.

All 70 recorded device/method/sequence-length configurations; successful values retained at original precision. Original MB fields represent MiB. Failed and unreported configurations retain blank measurements.
All 951 original synchronized timing repetitions for the 65 successful configurations. Warmup and first-call initialization excluded; numerical values unchanged.
All 24 fine-resolution and coarse-resolution seed records. Coarse runs use fine-bin augmentation followed by pooling and match the native and retimed accuracy protocol.

units.paired_epoch_speedup: same-seed fine mean epoch duration divided by coarse mean epoch duration

files.transformation: Means and sample SD across three training seeds; speedup is the ratio of fine-resolution and coarse-resolution seed means. Recomputed and verified by analyse-reference.

units.speedup_ratio_of_mean_epoch_times: dimensionless ratio of mean epoch durations

files.transformation: Source digests, hardware/software settings, numerical correctness gates and protocol matching. Source locations and private run identifiers omitted.

conventions.accuracy: Fraction in [0,1] unless a column ends in _pp or _percent.
conventions.sample_sd: Across seeds, denominator n-1; not the standard error.
conventions.gap: sampled accuracy minus mean-field accuracy, in percentage points.
conventions.paired_change: Intervention minus comparator for the same dataset, architecture and seed.
conventions.missing_values: Empty cells are unavailable or inapplicable, never zero.
conventions.certificate_accuracy: Correct and accepted predictions divided by all evaluated inputs; abstentions remain in the denominator.
conventions.certificate_disagreements: Disagreements between accepted decisions and the resolved reference decision; they are not automatically violations of a probabilistic bound.
conventions.runtime: Synchronized training-step medians from repeated measurements of a configuration; repetitions are not independent training seeds. Blank failed/unreported configurations are excluded from ratios.
conventions.coarse_speedup: Ratio of the fine-resolution mean epoch duration to the coarse-resolution mean epoch duration across the same seeds; not the mean of paired speedups.

matched_slope_protocol.selection: Highest mean-field validation accuracy evaluated at beta=5; strict improvement and earliest tie. All validation-selected checkpoints sealed before test evaluation. Previously studied SHD test data; no unseen-test claim.
matched_slope_protocol.optimizer: AdamW; learning rate 0.001; weight decay 0.0001; cosine schedule over 100 epochs; batch size 128; gradient clip 1.
matched_slope_protocol.checkpoint_availability: Hashes identify the archived selected checkpoints; hashes alone do not supply the weights.
